label.purpose: Uppercase context, timing, and data labels.

micro.purpose: Graph edges, certificate notes, and tight table headers.

motion.name: live-pulse
motion.purpose: Active run status only; disabled when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Starts the full experiment or returns from an empty state.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid #b9ed74; border-radius: 4px; padding: .72rem 1rem; background: #b9ed74; color: #17200e; font: 700 .76rem/1.2 'Geist Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .055em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #d1ff96; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b9ed74; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Runs an ablation or downloads the certificate.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 42px; border: 1px solid #263029; border-radius: 4px; padding: .72rem 1rem; background: #141b17; color: #eef5ef; font: 700 .76rem/1.2 'Geist Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .055em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: #536057; background: #18201b; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b9ed74; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Run Provenance
components.description: Keeps fixture and real Mozaik results unmistakably distinct.
components.css: .ds-provenance { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #ff8d7d 45%, #263029); border-radius: 999px; padding: .28rem .52rem; color: #ff8d7d; font: 600 .66rem/1.2 'Geist Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-provenance:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #b9ed74; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Metric Panel
components.description: A flat ruled container for measured values.
components.css: .ds-panel { display: grid; gap: 8px; width: 240px; border: 1px solid #263029; border-radius: 6px; padding: 16px; background: #0e1311; color: #eef5ef; font: 600 1.25rem/1.2 'Geist Mono', monospace; } .ds-panel-label { color: #8c9b91; font-size: .625rem; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-panel:focus-within { border-color: #b9ed74; }

components.name: Live Reaction Trace
components.description: The signature proof device linking one recorded output to a live response.
components.css: .ds-trace { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto auto; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 420px; color: #eef5ef; font: 600 .7rem/1.2 'Geist Mono', monospace; } .ds-trace i { height: 1px; border-top: 1px dashed #b9ed74; } .ds-trace b { border: 1px solid #263029; border-radius: 3px; padding: 4px 7px; background: #090c0b; color: #b9ed74; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: ConcurProof feels like the shared display in a production incident room: dense, calm, trustworthy, and immediately inspectable. Its drama comes from recorded activity crossing agent lanes, not from ambient effects, terminal cosplay, or decorative AI motifs. Off-black layers, crisp rules, compact typography, and one pale chartreuse signal make the interface feel instrument-like. The signature is the live reaction trace connecting a public agent output to another agent's response. It reads as evidence, not ornament.
keyCharacteristics: One signal color reserved for action and causality
Monospaced numerals, timestamps, evidence codes, and run IDs
Motion only for live state and direct feedback

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Reaction Signal marks the current action, live state, or recorded causal relationship. Inactive structure stays neutral.

rules.name: The Numeric Rail Rule
rules.body: Every latency, score, timestamp, run ID, and evidence ID uses tabular monospaced figures.

rules.name: The Flat Evidence Rule
rules.body: If regions can be separated by spacing, alignment, tone, or one hairline, do not make either a floating card.

dos: Do make provenance visible wherever a score or run result appears.
Do preserve familiar button, disclosure, table, and link behavior.
Do let recorded events determine every timeline mark, edge, and number.
Do honor reduced motion and maintain keyboard-visible focus.
Do retain the wide instrument view through deliberate internal scrolling on small screens.
donts: Don't use purple-blue AI gradients, glowing borders, fake terminal chrome, or decorative grid noise.
Don't invent decorative metrics, status lights, or activity outside recorded data.
Don't hide failures or let fixture output resemble a real model run.
Don't use display type in controls or dense data labels.
Don't replace structural rules with routine shadows or floating cards.
